proposals.title: Proposal 5—Stockholder Proposal Regarding Change in Control Policy
proposals.proponent: Comptroller of the State of New York, as trustee of the New York State Common Retirement Fund; Chevy Chase Trust, as trustee of the AFL-CIO Equity Index Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Adopt a policy prohibiting acceleration of vesting of equity awards for senior executives upon a change in control, except pro rata vesting up to termination.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal 5 for the following reasons:

proposals.title: Proposal 6—Stockholder Proposal Regarding Share Retention Policy
proposals.proponent: International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers Pension Benefit Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Adopt a policy requiring senior executives to retain a significant percentage of equity-compensation shares until normal retirement age or termination, with at least 50% retention and no hedging.
